hero.description: Hi, I'm Elliot. At 23, I'm based in the heart of the Lille metropolitan area. My journey began in lines of code, where logic meets creation. Today, I bridge developers and clients: translating business needs into technical solutions, and back again. What drives me is combining technical rigor with a human approach.

reassurance.contactDesc: Whether it's a Shopify migration, a complex ERP integration, or a custom store launch, I personally respond to every request. First response within 48 business hours.

contactPage.h1: Let's design your next technical milestone together
contactPage.intro: Because a large-scale e-commerce project is more than just code, I support you in defining your software architecture. Whether you're considering a Shopify Plus migration, automating complex ERP flows or building a custom business application, my role is to translate your business challenges into a robust and scalable technical roadmap.

Thriving in my current role at HUGGII for 3 years, I've built a rare profile: a Full Stack developer who leads as confidently as they code. If a genuinely exciting opportunity comes along, I'm open to hearing about it.
contactPage.h2Why: What I bring to your team
contactPage.reason1Desc: Full Stack Developer and Project Lead: I understand the code I orchestrate and manage the projects I build. A dual skill set that's hard to find.
contactPage.reason2Desc: Complex ERP integrations, Shopify migrations, custom applications. Delivered projects, satisfied clients, skills grounded in real challenges.
contactPage.reason3Desc: Open to a permanent on-site or hybrid role in the Lille metropolitan area. No full remote — a team, a workspace, a shared project.

aboutPage.heroDesc: Project Lead & Full Stack Developer for 3 years at HUGGII. This page is the person behind the projects.
aboutPage.bioText: My path wasn't mapped out from the start. By listening to the people around me, trusting my teachers' guidance, and working with determination, I became who I am today. My journey — from training to real-world projects — has allowed me to reveal and affirm skills I've always carried.
aboutPage.methodSubtitle: The combination of technical expertise, organisation and human management is what makes the difference on a project.
aboutPage.method1Desc: I work in regular sprints with check-ins by video call, phone or email. My goal is to always keep the client informed — this presence reassures and builds genuine trust.
aboutPage.method2Desc: With every team member, my role is to maximise their strengths. A successful project is a team where each person brings their absolute best.
aboutPage.method3Desc: Technical skill, rigorous organisation and human management: I lead with all three dimensions in mind on every project, from scoping to delivery.

realisationsPage.heroDescription: 3 years building demanding e-commerce solutions. From a well-crafted Shopify launch to complex ERP integration, every project here reflects solid work — on both the technical and the leadership side.
